subject: 江孜宗山 · 宗山城堡现状（自县城仰视）
name: 江孜宗山
sub: 宗山城堡现状 · 1904年抗英遗址
yearNote: 藏历火兔年（967年）吐蕃王室后裔白阔赞在宗山创建宫堡式建筑；据Dorje，1268年筑今城墙、1365年帕巴贝桑布建宫殿，其子贡嘎帕巴扩建并迁治于此；Vitali定城堡建于1390年。1904年江孜保卫战中英军炮火轰塌城墙，1967年城墙再遭炸毁，此后逐步修复，现状多为修复面貌。年表取14世纪筑堡的约略定位。
place: 西藏 · 日喀则 · 江孜
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q1297848（江孜宗山抗英遗址）P625 坐标 28.91782, 89.59921，宗山本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_gyantse（与白居寺共用）。
lede: 年楚河谷的江孜宗山，967年起就是吐蕃王裔白阔赞的宫堡；14世纪帕竹时期江孜法王在此建宫筑堡，成为西藏十三大宗之一。1904年英军入侵，守军在这座山堡上抵抗了约一百天，7月5日至6日七次击退进攻，7日城破——今天层层叠上山顶的白墙赭檐，是劫后修复的宗山。
facts: 年代：藏历火兔年（967年）白阔赞在宗山创建宫堡；1365年帕巴贝桑布建宫殿，14世纪末筑城堡，帕竹时期为西藏十三大宗之一；1961年列第一批国保。
1904：英军入侵西藏，江孜保卫战自4月持续约百日；7月5日至6日英军七次进攻均被击退，炮火轰塌城墙后于7月7日占领宗山。
现状：城堡在1904年战火与1967年爆破中严重损毁，此后逐步修复；建筑沿山脊层层叠上，白墙、赭红檐带，仍俯瞰江孜县城与年楚河平原。
caption: 江孜宗山 · 宗山城堡现状
14世纪筑堡 · 1904年抗英
structure_checkpoints: 城堡沿山脊自左向右上方层层叠高：左侧与中部为数座白墙平顶的碉楼状建筑和连绵的白色围墙，墙顶一律为赭红色檐带；右下为一排两层白墙建筑，右侧有一条长长的阶梯状挡墙与台阶斜向上行至山顶。
山顶主堡为最高大的白墙体量，墙体收分明显，开多排小方窗，顶部赭红边玛墙带，最高处右侧立一座小型金顶/宝瓶；主堡左侧与下方有多个退台的白墙建筑。
全部为土石砌白墙平顶建筑，无坡屋顶；山体裸岩以少量轮廓线表示，近处民房、树木、电线去除。
material_observations: 墙面白色（带土黄与红褐色水渍），檐带赭红，窗洞为深色小方窗，台阶与挡墙浅灰白，山体为土黄色裸岩与碎石。

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: Gyantse Dzong (江孜宗山), the hilltop fortress above Gyantse, drawn as the whole hill-and-fortress silhouette seen from the town in Image 2 (Image 3 shows the main keep from another side for proportions). Draw the rocky ridge rising from left to right with the fortress buildings stepping up along it: several flat-roofed whitewashed blocks and long white enclosure walls with dark parapet bands on the lower and middle slopes, a row of two-storey white buildings at the lower right, and a long stepped stair-wall climbing diagonally on the right. At the summit the tall main keep: a massive battered white block pierced by several rows of small square windows, topped by a dark parapet band and a small finial at its upper right, with lower stepped blocks at its left and below it. Everything is flat-roofed; no pitched roofs. Indicate the hill with a few sparse contour strokes only. Remove trees, wires, modern houses in the foreground and sky.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
